About AtomsAI

It started with a phone call.
It didn't stop there.

We started SaaS Labs in 2016 to make business communication simpler. Today our technology powers over a billion conversations a year. Each one showed us more to build.

Hello1,000,000,183conversations a year
  1. How it started

    A simpler way to talk

    SaaS Labs began with one product: a simpler phone system for sales and support teams.

  2. What we build

    The whole stack

    Applications, speech models, real-time infrastructure, and custom engineering, each one strengthening the others.

  3. What's next

    Bigger problems

    A decade in, we're taking on harder problems with the same belief that got us started.

What the calls taught us

The real world had more to say

Three things kept coming up in the calls. Solving them took us beyond business software, into speech models, real-time infrastructure, and the intelligence that turns conversations into action.

  • 01

    People interrupt

    Real conversations overlap, pause, and change direction mid-sentence.

  • 02

    Phone lines distort voices

    Narrow audio, noise, and accents break models trained on clean speech.

  • 03

    Questions expect action

    Customers ask the unexpected and expect something to happen next.

How the pieces feed each other

One breakthrough made the next possible

  1. Applications

    Show us what businesses need.

  2. Models & infrastructure

    Help us solve it.

  3. Custom engineering

    Takes us into problems no product covers.

What we learn building one strengthens the others.

That's how SaaS Labs grew into AtomsAI.

The people

Four kinds of work, one problem

Research, engineering, go-to-market, and support work on the same conversations, from the model to the customer who depends on it.

See open roles
  1. 01 / 04

    Research

    Speech and language models built for phone-quality audio, accents, and interruptions.

  2. 02 / 04

    Engineering

    Real-time infrastructure and the applications that put it to work.

  3. 03 / 04

    Go-to-market

    Helping businesses find, adopt, and get results from what we build.

  4. 04 / 04

    Support

    With customers around the clock, in every time zone we serve.

Where we work

Built in India. Put to work around the world

Headquartered in Bengaluru, with customers in more than 20 countries.
